evidence_boundaries: Manuscript four-row module table compares deployed configurations: SRC contains birth class-confidence gate 0.70; EGIA-only uses a native-branch refit without summary fusion; full uses frozen full fusion. It does not establish independent module main effects or additive interactions.
Pure-v5 refit comparison is separate: its SRC birth initialization differs from A02 and its refitted both lacks full fusion. It cannot replace manuscript A02/A06 or current F00 scores.
Frozen SRC cost includes coarse-class appearance mask plus learned semantic_penalty. Existing cost contrasts cannot attribute the full effect solely to learned semantic_penalty.
Hard-update and F00 have identical 17 prediction files and metrics; incremental MOT benefit of learned responsibility over hard update is not demonstrated.

With EGIA enabled, update_only and no_src predictions are identical. Frozen EGIA source/coherence and summary scorers ignore SRC belief fields; belief reaches trajectories through subsequent association cost.

F00 versus cost_only differs by one FP and has near-zero recurrent-update gain. Native N4 versus N2 differs by two FP and is slightly worse. Recurrent update is not established as necessary for current performance.
noSOE and pair_shuffle online controls are completed; they are distinct from the 8411 fixed-development-event NLL diagnostic.
Gated EGIA-only was retrospectively selected on test-dev with branch refits, not untouched calibration or a fixed-model gate-only effect.

A04/A05/A06 are existing selective/fusion controls in the current method development lineage; A06 matches current F00 predictions. Teacher-loading fields differ at fusion enablement. Reuse depends on declaring the actual deployment configuration, not claiming a generic host-independent effect.
These are local-evaluator test-dev diagnostics, not a new official-server score, independent replication, or significance claim. No legacy H2 score substitutes for current F00.
